description: Tinny has agreed to teach you about trickery, but first she requires ingredients for a Witch’s Brew, in exchange for an apprenticeship. Be wary of immature Reedflute as Tinny demands only the mature spiked Reedflute for her brew.
name: An Intoxicating Brew
completed: You've gathered all of Tinny's ingredients , take the ingredients back to continue your training.
